title: CR-BRK-013 — AP/AR OFF — Unpaid/Payments/Credits tabs leak (customer & vendor)
preconds: Customers V \u2713 | Vendor & Order V \u2713 | Parts Dept \u2713 | Manage AP/AR \u2717 | See Financial \u2713 | WO V \u2713 | View Mode: Full (View Mode as specified).
steps:
1. Configure a custom role per the Setup in Preconditions; assign to a test user and log in.
  2. Open a customer detail page and a vendor detail page; confirm all three tabs are absent on each.
expected:
Unpaid Invoices / Payments / Credits tabs hidden on BOTH customer and vendor detail pages (§5b OFF). AP/AR aging reports hidden from Reports.

Risk / Rationale: Tabs leak on the customer and/or vendor page despite AP/AR OFF.
Spec Ref: §5b Manage AP/AR
